actions.title: Release the queue
actions.trigger: Any Held shipment >5 days or Held revenue >5% of portfolio.
actions.release: Held revenue <5%; approved routes sustain ≥95% DIFOT for two weekly reviews.

actions.title: Reopen material account terms
actions.trigger: Cell sensitivity/revenue >25%, Held revenue >$1m, or contribution-negative cell.

actions.title: Gate the route premium
actions.trigger: Recovered surcharge + avoided loss fails to cover current quoted premium.
actions.release: Use lower-cost feasible mode once service/economic hurdle clears.

actions.title: Re-insure by corridor
actions.trigger: Recorded burden >1.5% of cargo value or top-quartile insurance burden.
actions.release: Burden <0.75% for 60 days with better premium + retained loss.

actions.title: Stop unrecoverable offers
actions.trigger: Negative contribution persists after route, price, insurance and service redesign.
actions.release: Re-enter only with positive prospective contribution and enforceable recovery.
